Question 7
?

Consider the function f(x)=sin⁡(4x+π4). Which expression gives all of the values of x at which f(x) attains its maximum value? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=π8+n⋅π16
b
x=π16+n⋅π2
c
x=π2+nπ
d
x=π16+n⋅π4
e
x=π8+nπ
